name_cn: 浙江华艺盛纺织股份有限公司
main_products: Plain and high-twist voile, chiffon fabric (greige and printed/dyed); also scarves and Muslim headscarves
woven_evidence: Zhejiang CCPIT profile says it has more than 420 looms and makes over 30 million m of greige and 60 million m of printed/dyed voile and chiffon a year. It also led the group standard for woven (机织) headscarves.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Huzhou government's booth allocation list for the 137th Canton Fair, Phase 3, gives 浙江华艺盛纺织股份有限公司 2 booths in the textile raw materials and fabrics zone (纺织原料面料).

notes: Exports to the Middle East and Arab markets (http://www.ccpitzj.gov.cn/art/2024/7/2/art_1229631368_44903.html). A large share of output is scarves and hijabs, which are accessories, so Layer 2 should confirm how much of the business is voile and chiffon dress fabric.
